title: Gate S2D's 2x2 criterion (mean f >= 0.1, worst f >= 0.05) re-evaluated on the idle-aware clean-shot fraction, at both ends of the T2 bracket

criteria.name: V1 gate-only f reproduces validation/S2D.json (FakeFez mean and worst)
V2 f on the record equals gate_S2D.analyse_on_backend over the 28 circuits
V3 the ASAP schedule reproduces h0_qpu_time.circuit_duration_s
V4 the B0_ref06_k1_rep1 budget reproduces the committed idle model of the frozen set
V5 hardware anchor: idle-aware (echo T2) predicts 30.8 accepted of 2000, measured 35
C FakeFez / Hahn-echo T2: mean idle-aware f over the 28 circuits (DD off)
C FakeFez / Hahn-echo T2: worst-circuit idle-aware f (DD off)
C FakeFez / measured T2*: mean idle-aware f over the 28 circuits (DD off)
C FakeFez / measured T2*: worst-circuit idle-aware f (DD off)
C live ibm_fez / Hahn-echo T2: mean idle-aware f over the 28 circuits (DD off)
C live ibm_fez / Hahn-echo T2: worst-circuit idle-aware f (DD off)
C live ibm_fez / measured T2*: mean idle-aware f over the 28 circuits (DD off)
C live ibm_fez / measured T2*: worst-circuit idle-aware f (DD off)
C most favourable point of the whole bracket (live record, echo T2, rho = 0: DD refocuses the eligible windows perfectly): mean f

data.what_changed: f now includes idle-time relaxation over the circuit's own ASAP schedule (skqd.idle); the thresholds 0.1 and 0.05 are unchanged and gate_S2D.analyse_on_backend is untouched

criterion.f_model: f = f_gates x exp(-S_idle), f_gates = gate_S2D.analyse_on_backend, S_idle = S_T1 + S_T2 (DD off) or S_T1 + rho S_T2_eligible + S_T2_ineligible + S_DD (DD on)

data.circuit_family: exact structured circuits, CircuitFactory default; coarse steps k = 1..4 of every reference of both sectors (validation/S2.json)

t2_bracket.source: validation/H0_diag.json data.idle_tests.J1.ramw (windowed Ramsey, total delay 43.52 us)
t2_bracket.note: T2_record is the calibration's Hahn-echo T2; a fully dephased qubit contributes its 3-sigma upper bound, a qubit with neither contributes nothing and takes the fallback ratio like any unmeasured qubit

implication_2x3.source: data/S2D_2x3_device_requirements.json (counts and declared inputs; the sheet itself is unchanged)

rows.unreachable: the idle budget S_idle = 3.507 alone puts f below 0.1: the criterion is unreachable at any gate error on this schedule

implication_2x3.note: S_idle at 2x3 is NOT computed here: the all-to-all device has no declared gate durations and no declared T1/T2, so its schedule cannot be built.  The rows are the requirement AS A FUNCTION of whatever S_idle it turns out to have; the largest S_idle in the table is the 2x2/Heron value measured on the live record (section 4), shown for scale only.
